title.en: old things market at bazar na kole.
title.tr: bazar na kole'de eski eşya pazarı.

line.en: the sunday old-things market on obozowa street. the busy part is roughly 07:00 to 13:00 and most stalls pack up by early afternoon, so go early.
line.de: der sonntägliche trödelmarkt an der obozowa. das meiste passiert etwa zwischen 7:00 und 13:00; gegen mittag packen die meisten ein, also früh hin.
line.tr: obozowa caddesi'ndeki pazar günü eski eşya pazarı. en yoğun saatler kabaca 07:00-13:00; tezgâhların çoğu öğleden sonra toplanıyor, erken git.

sparks.why: Bazar na Kole, Obozowa 99, Sunday old-things market: listings give about 6:00 to 14:00 or 15:00 (targeo.pl, warsawwanderer.pl, bazavintage.pl); busy hours per the Warsaw wiki. Hours not confirmed on the organiser's page.
